identity.name: AppleScript Cryptocurrency Wallet Access via Command Line
identity.summary: An attacker executes an AppleScript through the command line to access cryptocurrency wallet data, leveraging automation to extract wallet information. Cortex should detect the unusual AppleScript exe
identity.description: An attacker executes an AppleScript through the command line to access cryptocurrency wallet data, leveraging automation to extract wallet information. Cortex should detect the unusual AppleScript execution pattern and command-line invocation.

payload.code: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "WalletApp" to get the name of every application process'

expected_artifacts.description: AppleScript process started via command line

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon AppleScript Execution via Command Line
biocs.description: Detection of AppleScript execution initiated directly from command line without GUI interaction
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'Terminal' and actor_process_image_name != 'iTerm2'
| filter action_file_path contains '/usr/bin/osascript'

abiocs.name: Unusual AppleScript Behavior for Wallet Data Access
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where AppleScript is used to access wallet application processes
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_file_path contains 'System Events'
| filter action_file_path contains 'WalletApp'
abiocs.causality_anchor: osascript process initiated from command line

xql_queries.name: Detect AppleScript Access to Wallet Processes
xql_queries.query:
